---
title: Apps del taller
subtitle: Shiny + ellmer · patrones progresivos
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

Cada ejemplo se ejecuta en un proceso independiente. Puedes probarlo aquí o abrirlo en otra pestaña.

```{r}
#| results: asis
root <- Sys.getenv("SHINY_APP_ROOT")
apps <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("SHINY_APP_NAMES"), ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
ports <- as.integer(strsplit(Sys.getenv("SHINY_APP_PORTS"), ";", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])

if (!nzchar(root) || !length(apps) || length(apps) != length(ports)) {
  stop("Inicia este catálogo con R/run_all_apps.R.")
}

escape_html <- function(text) {
  text <- gsub("&", "&amp;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub("<", "&lt;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  text <- gsub(">", "&gt;", text, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub('"', "&quot;", text, fixed = TRUE)
}

for (index in seq_along(apps)) {
  app <- apps[index]
  metadata <- read.dcf(file.path(root, app, "DESCRIPTION"))[1, ]
  title <- unname(metadata["Title"])
  html_title <- escape_html(title)
  description <- escape_html(unname(metadata["Description"]))
  url <- sprintf("http://127.0.0.1:%d", ports[index])

  cat(
    '\n\n::: {.app-entry .column-page}\n\n',
    '## ', title, ' {#', app, '}\n\n',
    '<div class="app-meta"><code>', app, '</code></div>',
    '<p class="app-description">', description, '</p>',
    '<div class="iframe-preview">',
    '<iframe src="', url, '" title="', html_title, '" loading="lazy"></iframe>',
    '</div>',
    '\n\n:::\n\n',
    sep = ""
  )
}
```
